scope: Root static syntax/source-handoff preflight only; no QEMU or USB execution

checks.stdout:
usage: run-secure-qemu.py [-h] [--kernel KERNEL] --backend
                          {virtual,usbfs,native} --family {ipv4,ipv6}
                          [--timeout TIMEOUT] --evidence EVIDENCE
                          [--skip-build]

Two disposable guests: actual mTLS catalog/IMPORT/URB, kernel VHCI and I/O.
One isolated NIC socketpair is the complete external link. Host coordination,
evidence, QMP and simulated FTDI are separate Unix/serial channels. No host
USB, tap, public listener, module load or product stand-in is used. Virtual,
USBFS and Native secure servers x IPv4/IPv6 are six distinct actual-product
runs.

  --backend {virtual,usbfs,native}
